# Mr Meat & Co
> Sydney's Premier Craft Butcher & Grass-Fed Beef Direct to Door

Mr Meat & Co is Sydney's artisanal craft butcher delivering 100% Australian grass-fed beef, premium beef mince, free-range poultry, grass-fed lamb, and custom butcher freezer boxes directly to your door with temperature-controlled cold-chain express delivery.

## Contact & Business Info
- Legal entity: Mr Meat & Co — ABN 71 635 847 908 (verify at https://abr.business.gov.au/ABN/View?abn=71635847908)
- Email: [orders@mrmeatandco.com.au](mailto:orders@mrmeatandco.com.au)
- WhatsApp: [+61400000000](https://wa.me/61400000000)
- Headquarters: Sydney, NSW, Australia
- Minimum Order: $300 AUD
- Free Shipping: Free refrigerated delivery on all orders ($300 min) across Sydney Metro
- Payment Methods: PayID, Direct Bank Transfer, Bitcoin (BTC), Tether (USDT)
- Crypto Discount: Instant 10% discount applied to PayID and Crypto direct checkouts

## Product Categories
- [Beef & Mince](https://mrmeatandco.com.au/shop/beef/): 100% Australian grass-fed beef, premium beef mince, dry-aged steaks, and slow-cooking roasts.
- [Australian Lamb](https://mrmeatandco.com.au/shop/lamb/): Tender pasture-raised NSW grass-fed lamb cutlets, frenched racks, legs, and diced cuts.
- [Pork & Poultry](https://mrmeatandco.com.au/shop/pork-poultry/): Free-range pasture-raised whole chicken, organic breasts, and free-range pork cuts.
- [Sausages & Smallgoods](https://mrmeatandco.com.au/shop/smallgoods/): Artisanal gluten-free sausages, dry-cured bacon, smoked meats, and smallgoods.
- [Bulk & Butcher Boxes](https://mrmeatandco.com.au/shop/bundles/): Curated freezer stocker boxes, household meat packs, and wholesale bulk bundles.
